races.paceDynamic: Esherann is the clear pace angle, likely to lead from the start with minimal early pressure from this field of predominantly prominent and hold-up horses. Lir Speciale, Our Havana, and Leadman may track close but none are confirmed pace pressers, allowing Esherann to dictate fractions. The large field of 21 runners with many hold-up horses suggests traffic problems and positioning battles in the straight. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure clean runs, while hold-up horses face significant tactical disadvantages in such a crowded field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Esherann gets uncontested early fractions and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The pace-setter kicks clear turning for home as the field bunches behind, with only prominent trackers able to mount a challenge. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic and fail to find racing room when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is modest and prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The patient prominent runners time their moves perfectly as Esherann begins to tire, sweeping past in the final furlong. Traffic problems behind help those who positioned early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the large field causes a messy pace and severe congestion in the straight
scenarios.body: Multiple hold-up horses get boxed in and fail to secure clear runs, allowing the early positioned horses to dominate the finish. Late runners struggle for gaps and momentum.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and gaps miraculously appear late
scenarios.body: One or two hold-up horses find the perfect passage through traffic to mount a telling late challenge. The early leaders pay for their efforts in a slowly-run race.

races.paceDynamic: Dandana is the only confirmed front-runner and will likely get an uncontested lead, creating a sustainable gallop rather than any early burn-up. Behind her, the mass of prominent runners - Rhyme Dust, Lady Roxby, Splish Splash, Cool Molly, Siouxpersonic and Bintaryana - will track in a pack, while the hold-up pair Beaujolais Nouveau and Mercury Day drop in behind. With no pace pressure early, Dandana can dictate fractions and potentially kick clear, while the prominent trackers get the ideal trip to mount challenges. This race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent racers who can secure good early positions without expending energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Dandana gets soft fractions and isn't headed turning in
scenarios.body: Her sustainable pace becomes a tactical masterstroke as she finds extra when challenged, holding off all late comers. The lack of early pace pressure allows her to save energy for a decisive final furlong kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack stays patient behind Dandana's steady gallop
scenarios.body: One of the well-positioned trackers times their challenge perfectly, sweeping past the leader in the final 100 yards. The ideal stalking trip pays dividends against both the exposed leader and struggling hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes slower than anticipated
scenarios.body: Beaujolais Nouveau or Mercury Day get the perfect setup to unleash a devastating late kick from off the pace. The lack of early speed allows them to close ground dramatically in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaotic Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners challenge Dandana simultaneously turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with 4-5 horses hitting the front together in the final furlong. Superior fitness and recent form become decisive factors in a blanket finish.

races.paceDynamic: Astro King will look to make the running from his prominent position, with multiple prominent racers including Antipodes, Rathgar, Love Beach, and Spioradalta likely to press forward early, creating a competitive pace from the outset. The sustained galloping nature of York's 1m2½f trip means the early leaders will need to be strategic about their positioning, but with so many keen types wanting to race handily, a solid tempo is assured. The hold-up horses like Wahdan, Castle Stuart, Per Contra, and Dark Moon Rising will rely on the pace being strong enough to set up their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers who can secure good early positions without being trapped wide, as they'll have tactical control over the sustained pace that this trip demands.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace settles into a rhythm allowing prominent horses to stay in touch without excessive early pressure
scenarios.body: The leaders can dictate terms and kick clear in the straight, leaving hold-up horses with too much ground to make up. Antipodes and Rathgar are best positioned to exploit their handy positions with their current form figures.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses engage in early pace pressure and compromise each other
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up perfectly for the closers who can produce sustained finishing efforts over this stamina-testing trip. Wahdan's French form and Castle Stuart's hold-up style become major assets.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Astro King or another pace-setter gets an easy lead and the field allows soft fractions
scenarios.body: The leader can control the race from pillar to post, building an unassailable advantage that the closers cannot bridge. Astro King's experience and recent placed efforts make him the prime beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely or becomes extremely messy with interference
scenarios.body: Horses positioned in the middle of the pack can pick their way through and benefit from a truly-run race where positioning matters more than pure ability. The competitive handicap nature opens doors for outsiders.

races.paceDynamic: Schrodinger's Cat will set a strong pace from the front with Forest Phoenix and Simba's Pride tracking close behind in the early stages. The sustained gallop will stretch the field with several prominent runners like Adalida, Empress Olivia and Houndrill also going forward early. This creates a solid tempo that will test stamina reserves over the minimum trip. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay out of trouble and finish with one run, as the pace pressure will leave front-runners vulnerable in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is truly honest and the front group goes too fast
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will find out the stamina reserves of the pace-setters, allowing horses like Vinciamo, Under The Radar and Straight Ahead to pick up the pieces late. These closers can stay out of early trouble and deliver one decisive run when it matters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If one of the early prominent horses can control their effort and kick again
scenarios.body: Forest Phoenix or Simba's Pride could dictate terms from an ideal position just behind the leader and have enough left to repel late challenges. Their recent form suggests they can handle this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Mid-Division
scenarios.trigger: If Schrodinger's Cat goes too fast and the prominent runners also get drawn into speed
scenarios.body: Horses positioned in mid-division like Angel Numbers or Rotokura Belle can benefit from a pace collapse scenario. They avoid early pace pressure but are close enough to strike when the leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Schrodinger's Cat can dictate more moderate fractions than expected
scenarios.body: The consistent front runner can control the race from the front and resist all challenges, using superior tactical position to maximum advantage. Recent course form gives confidence in this scenario.

races.paceDynamic: Say What You See and Dovey Moon will set a solid tempo from the front, with prominent runners Harry The Rogue, Naples, and Mao Shang Wong tracking closely behind. The large field suggests the pace will be genuine but not frantic, with multiple layers forming as hold-up horses Epictetus, Northwest Passage, and Mafting settle at the rear. The sustained nature of 1m2½f at York means those tracking the pace in prominent positions will have the tactical advantage, avoiding the traffic problems that often plague hold-up horses in big handicap fields. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers who can position handy and kick when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest without collapsing
scenarios.body: The handy horses avoid traffic and can quicken when needed, while hold-up runners struggle to find room in the large field. Those positioned 3rd-6th throughout get first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong and collapses
scenarios.body: The front-runners and prominent trackers come back to the field dramatically in the final furlong. Late runners with clear passages find winning positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Say What You See gets soft fractions and stays clear
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable lead as the large field gets strung out behind. Those tracking closest benefit most from the slipstream.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If the field bunches up approaching the home turn
scenarios.body: Multiple horses get badly hampered and the race becomes a lottery for those finding daylight. Any runner getting a clear run can capitalise.
